what_it_does: Express a ROCK isoform carrying an ATP-pocket mutation that lowers Y-27632 affinity, in explants or in chondrocytes reaggregated into a pellet. If the geometry phenotype is on-target it is abolished in the resistant background.
feasibility: genetic, feasible in transduced pellet culture; hard in intact explant
what_it_proves: cleanest possible on-target proof; distinguishes ROCK from every other kinase Y-27632 touches

design: constitutively active ROCK / MLC phosphomimetic epistasis
what_it_does: Co-deliver a constitutively active ROCK fragment, or a phosphomimetic MLC, alongside the inhibitor. If the phenotype is ROCK-substrate driven it is reversed downstream of the drug.
feasibility: genetic; places the effect above or below MLC phosphorylation
what_it_proves: distinguishes 'ROCK activity' from 'actomyosin tension' as the operative variable

what_it_does: Partial shRNA/siRNA knockdown of ROCK1 versus ROCK2 separately. The isoform whose knockdown phenocopies is the necessary one.
feasibility: genetic; the only route to the isoform question, since no available compound is isoform-selective enough
what_it_proves: answers stage 68's question 5, which chemistry cannot

what_it_does: Add mevalonate to the medium alongside the statin. Mevalonate is downstream of HMGCR, so a genuine HMGCR-mediated phenotype is rescued and an off-target one is not. This is the single most informative experiment in the whole statin arm.
what_it_proves: if mevalonate does not rescue, the phenotype is not HMGCR and the statin arm ends

design: branch-point add-back: GGPP versus FPP versus cholesterol
what_it_does: Separate add-backs of geranylgeranyl pyrophosphate, farnesyl pyrophosphate and LDL/cholesterol. Whichever restores the phenotype identifies the branch: prenylation (GGPP/FPP) or sterol.
feasibility: pharmacological; the decomposition the brief explicitly asks for
what_it_proves: separates prenylation from cholesterol from RORalpha, which no statin alone can

what_it_does: A direct RORalpha inverse agonist/agonist run in parallel. If the statin phenotype is RORalpha-mediated, the direct ligand reproduces it and GGPP add-back does not rescue.
what_it_proves: the anchor paper's RORalpha thread is tested rather than assumed

what_it_does: Co-treat with a SMO agonist (purmorphamine or SAG). A competitive SMO-driven phenotype is reversed; an off-target one is not.
feasibility: pharmacological; direct opposing perturbation at the same protein
what_it_proves: confirms the effect is at SMO rather than elsewhere in the cilium

what_it_does: Express constitutively active GLI2, or use a GLI antagonist, to place the phenotype above or below GLI. A SMO-driven phenotype is bypassed by active GLI.
what_it_proves: separates 'SMO antagonism' from 'general Hedgehog suppression', which the brief requires

what_it_does: SMO D473H (the clinical vismodegib-resistance allele) re-expression. The phenotype should disappear in that background.
feasibility: genetic; the strongest on-target proof available for this node
what_it_proves: a resistance allele is the gold standard for target assignment

what_it_does: Express non-phosphorylatable cofilin (S3A). LIMK acts by phosphorylating cofilin S3; if the phenotype runs through that phosphorylation it is abolished.
feasibility: genetic; places the effect precisely at the LIMK-cofilin step
what_it_proves: p-cofilin is both the engagement marker and the epistasis node, which is why LIMK is the cleanest of the five mechanistically

what_it_does: Separate LIMK1 and LIMK2 knockdown. LIMK2 is the more highly expressed isoform in cartilage in several datasets, and the compound's isoform preference has to be matched against which isoform is necessary.
what_it_proves: answers the LIMK1-versus-LIMK2 question chemistry cannot

what_it_does: No rescue can be designed until the causal node is identified. Bosutinib engages a broad kinase set; the deconvolution experiment is a matched panel of cleaner single-node inhibitors run side by side at their own selective concentrations.
what_it_proves: a rescue for an unassigned target is not interpretable, which is why bosutinib is held at DECONVOLUTION_REQUIRED
